title: Captions
summary: Ten caption styles in the theme look, playing over the sample clip with its real word timings: white sans capitals whose words or letters come up out of a soft blur as they are spoken. Nothing bounces; the two kinetic styles land each word a size too large and mark the storyboard’s emphasis words on a colour block.
usage: In a storyboard: {"captions": "one-word"}. one-word is the theme default (the caption is the single word of this style); tall-word is its condensed voice; phrase, hairline and small-print show a few words at a time. On bone cards white type disappears: use ink-bar or ink-word there. Styles: library/themes/fashion/captions/styles.js.
